# `jouet wind show`

- **Usage:** `jouet wind show <ID>`

Show a note or a proposal: what was noticed, and what was drafted

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`** — The id of a note (n3), a proposal (p2) or a suggested review (r1)

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
